# Media

Upload, browse, view, choose and crop pictures, sounds and video.

[MediaUploader](#mediauploader) · [MediaLibrary](#medialibrary) · [MediaViewer](#mediaviewer) · [MediaPicker](#mediapicker) · [MediaModeration](#mediamoderation) · [CroppedImage](#croppedimage) · [ImageCropper](#imagecropper)

### MediaUploader

Drop files or browse, and watch each one upload: it checks type, size, dimensions and length first, shows progress per file, and lets the person cancel or retry.

```ts
import { MediaUploader } from '@/contest/components/MediaUploader'
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `onUpload` *(required)* | `(file: File, options: { onProgress: (fraction: number) => void; signal: AbortSignal }) => Promise<MediaAsset>` |  | Sends one file. Report progress with `onProgress(0..1)` and stop when `signal` aborts. |
| `onUploaded` | `(asset: MediaAsset) => void` |  | Called once for every file that arrives safely. |
| `accept` | `string` | `'image/*'` | Allowed types, like the `accept` of a file input: `image/*`, `audio/*,video/*` or `application/pdf`. |
| `maxMb` | `number` | `5` | Largest file in megabytes. |
| `minWidth` | `number` |  | Smallest picture width in pixels. |
| `minHeight` | `number` |  | Smallest picture height in pixels. |
| `maxDurationSec` | `number` |  | Longest sound or video in seconds. |
| `multiple` | `boolean` | `true` | Accept more than one file. |
| `maxFiles` | `number` | `10` | Most files in one go. |
| `title` | `string` |  | Heading of the drop area. |
| `hint` | `string` |  | Replaces the line that lists the rules. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` |  | Switches the drop area off. |
| `className` | `string` |  | Extra classes. |

```tsx
const { upload } = useMedia()

<MediaUploader accept="image/*" maxMb={5} minWidth={800} onUpload={(file, o) => upload(file, o)} />
```

- A refused file is explained in words ("photo.png is larger than 5 MB."), not just rejected.
- Cancelling aborts the request through the `AbortSignal`. A cancelled or failed file shows a retry button.

### MediaLibrary

All uploaded files in a grid or list, with search, kind and tag filters, multiple choice, and a bulk delete that says how many questions would lose a file. MediaThumb is its small preview.

```ts
import { MediaLibrary } from '@/contest/components/MediaLibrary'
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `assets` *(required)* | `MediaAsset[]` |  | The files. |
| `usage` | `Record<string, number>` |  | How many questions use each file, by id. Shown on each card and warned about before a delete. |
| `selected` | `string[]` |  | The chosen ids. Leave out to let the library keep the choice itself. |
| `onSelectedChange` | `(ids: string[]) => void` |  | Called when the choice changes. |
| `maxSelect` | `number` |  | Most files that can be chosen. 1 picks a single file and a new choice replaces the old. |
| `kinds` | `Array<'image' \| 'audio' \| 'video' \| 'document'>` |  | Only these kinds are listed. |
| `onOpen` | `(asset: MediaAsset) => void` |  | Called when a file is clicked. Without it, clicking a file chooses it. |
| `onDelete` | `(assets: MediaAsset[]) => void` |  | Shows the delete button for chosen files. The library asks for confirmation first. |
| `actions` | `ReactNode` |  | Extra buttons on the right of the toolbar, for example an Upload button. |
| `className` | `string` |  | Extra classes. |

```tsx
<MediaLibrary assets={assets} usage={usage} onOpen={setViewing} onDelete={(list) => remove(list.map((a) => a.id))} />
```

- It lists and chooses; uploading, viewing and deleting are the page's job, through `actions`, `onOpen` and `onDelete`.
- Thumbnails follow each picture's saved crop and focal point.

### MediaViewer

One file in full: the picture (click to enlarge), a player for sound and video, a reader for PDFs, and the file's details. With `onSave` it also edits the description, caption, tags, crop and focal point.

```ts
import { MediaViewer } from '@/contest/components/MediaViewer'
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `asset` *(required)* | `MediaAsset` |  | The file to show. |
| `usage` | `number` |  | How many questions use the file. |
| `onSave` | `(asset: MediaAsset) => void` |  | Shows the edit fields and a Save button. Without it the viewer only shows. |
| `onPrev` | `() => void` |  | Shows a previous button. |
| `onNext` | `() => void` |  | Shows a next button. |
| `className` | `string` |  | Extra classes. |

```tsx
<Drawer open={!!viewing} onClose={() => setViewing(null)} title="Media">
  {viewing && <MediaViewer asset={viewing} usage={usage[viewing.id]} onSave={update} />}
</Drawer>
```

- Edits stay in a draft until Save. Changing to another file starts from that file.
- The picture is never changed: only the crop numbers are saved.

### MediaPicker

A dialog to choose files from the library, or to upload a new one on the spot. Use it behind every "Add picture" button.

```ts
import { MediaPicker } from '@/contest/components/MediaPicker'
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `open` *(required)* | `boolean` |  | Shows the dialog. |
| `onClose` *(required)* | `() => void` |  | Called when the dialog is cancelled. |
| `assets` *(required)* | `MediaAsset[]` |  | The library. |
| `usage` | `Record<string, number>` |  | Use counts, shown on the cards. |
| `kinds` | `Array<'image' \| 'audio' \| 'video' \| 'document'>` |  | Only these kinds can be chosen. |
| `multiple` | `boolean` | `false` | Choose several files. |
| `title` | `string` | `'Choose media'` | Dialog title. |
| `onPick` *(required)* | `(assets: MediaAsset[]) => void` |  | Called with the chosen files when the person confirms. |
| `onUpload` | `UploadHandler` |  | Adds an "Upload new" tab. A file that uploads is chosen for the person. |
| `accept` | `string` |  | Allowed types for the "Upload new" tab. By default they follow `kinds`. |

```tsx
<MediaPicker open={picking} onClose={() => setPicking(false)} assets={assets} kinds={['image']} onUpload={upload} onPick={([a]) => attach(a.id)} />
```

- The other upload rules of `MediaUploader` (`maxMb`, `minWidth`, `minHeight`, `maxDurationSec`) are accepted too and apply to the "Upload new" tab.

### MediaModeration

A wall for going through uploads quickly: arrow keys to move, A to approve, R to reject, F to flag, Z to undo.

```ts
import { MediaModeration } from '@/contest/components/MediaModeration'
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `assets` *(required)* | `MediaAsset[]` |  | All media. The wall shows those that are waiting for review or flagged. |
| `onModerate` *(required)* | `(asset: MediaAsset, state: ModerationState) => void` |  | Called with the file and the state to give it. Undo calls it with the old state. |
| `uploaderName` | `(id: string) => string \| undefined` |  | Turns an uploader id into a name for the card. |
| `className` | `string` |  | Extra classes. |

```tsx
<MediaModeration assets={assets} onModerate={(asset, moderation) => void media.update({ ...asset, moderation })} />
```

- A decided file leaves the wall at once and the next one is selected; the decision is sent in the background.
- Focus the wall (Tab to it, or click a card) and use the keys. Every card also has buttons for the mouse.

### CroppedImage

A picture shown through its saved crop, rotation and focal point. In a box of another shape it slides toward the focal point, so the subject stays in view.

```ts
import { CroppedImage } from '@/contest/components/CroppedImage'
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `asset` *(required)* | `MediaAsset` |  | The picture. Only url, name, alt, width, height, focal and transform are read. |
| `ratio` | `number` |  | Width ÷ height of the box, for example 1 for a square. Leave out to show the crop in its own shape. |
| `override` | `Pick<MediaAsset, 'transform' \| 'focal'>` |  | Replaces the asset's crop, for live previews while editing. |
| `alt` | `string` |  | Replaces the picture's description. |
| `className` | `string` |  | Extra classes. |

```tsx
<CroppedImage asset={asset} ratio={1} />   {/* a square thumbnail that keeps the subject */}
<CroppedImage asset={asset} ratio={16 / 9} />
```

- The file is never changed. The box shows the right part of it with plain CSS, so it costs nothing to show the same picture in many shapes.

### ImageCropper

Crop, rotate and set a focal point without touching the file. Live square, wide and tall previews show what the focal point does.

```ts
import { ImageCropper } from '@/contest/components/ImageCropper'
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `asset` *(required)* | `MediaAsset` |  | The picture. |
| `value` | `{ transform: Transform; focal: Point }` |  | The crop being edited. Leave out to start from what the asset has saved. |
| `onChange` *(required)* | `(value: { transform: Transform; focal: Point }) => void` |  | Called with the new crop and focal point, as fractions of the rotated picture. |
| `className` | `string` |  | Extra classes. |

```tsx
const [crop, setCrop] = useState(currentCrop(asset))

<ImageCropper asset={asset} value={crop} onChange={setCrop} />
<Button onClick={() => update({ ...asset, ...crop })}>Save</Button>
```

- Drag the box to move it, a handle to resize it, the dot to set the focal point. With the keyboard: Tab to the box, arrow keys move it (Shift for bigger steps), + and − resize it. Tab to the dot and use the arrow keys to move it.
- Choosing 1:1, 4:3 or 16:9 locks the shape of the box. Turning the picture turns the crop and the focal point with it.
